statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A valid packet arrived with unexpected type. For example, a DCCP-Data packet with valid header checksum and sequence numbers arrived at a connection in the REQUEST state.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: DCCP-Reset packets unconditionally shut down a connection.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: A valid packet arrived with unexpected type. For example, a DCCP-Data packet with valid header checksum and sequence numbers arrived at a connection in the REQUEST state. Reset Code 4, Packet Error.
statements.pre_cond: protocol.state = REQUEST & packet.checksum_valid = true & packet.sequence_numbers_valid = true
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 4 (Packet Error)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Connection Refused: The Destination Port didn't correspond to a port open for listening. Sent only in response to DCCP-Requests.
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 7 (Connection Refused)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Bad Service Code: The Service Code didn't equal the service code attached to the Destination Port. Sent only in response to DCCP-Requests.
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 8 (Bad Service Code)

statements.subject: server
statements.description: Too Busy: The server is too busy to accept new connections. Sent only in response to DCCP-Requests.
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 9 (Too Busy)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Options on DCCP-Reset packets are processed before the connection is shut down. This means that certain combinations of options, particularly involving Mandatory, may cause an endpoint to respond to a valid DCCP-Reset with another DCCP-Reset.
statements.trigger: receive DCCP-Reset with Mandatory option error
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 6 (Mandatory Error)

statements.subject: endpoint
statements.description: Bad Init Cookie: The Init Cookie echoed by the client was incorrect or missing.
statements.trigger: receive DCCP-Request with incorrect or missing Init Cookie
actions: send DCCP-Reset with Reset Code 10 (Bad Init Cookie)
